The '''Nak'tra crystal rifle''' was a type of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. It used a specially modified [[Nak'tra crystal]] beamsplitter to increase the power of the shots that it fired, which made it a very deadly weapon.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nak'tra crystal rifles appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
